data.name: Home.What.Title
data.value: What are we going to do?

data.name: Home.What.P1
data.value: The first real IT conference on a real festival site where IT and music come together in one place! With fantastic workshops where you learn by doing, share your experience and knowledge, and discover new talents.

data.name: Home.What.P2
data.value: The goal is to gain IT knowledge in a creative way, have fun, and enjoy live music. The festival takes place on a real open-air festival site in the style of Lowlands, Zwarte Cross, Down the Rabbit Hole and De Parade. Slightly smaller, of course, but with the same atmosphere and surroundings, in a beautiful spot between Arnhem and Nijmegen.

data.name: Home.What.P3
data.value: And in that same spirit we will, alongside music, enjoy talks and workshops where 'knowing and doing' are the primary goals. So no boring presentations, but interactive sessions on (Vibe-)coding, testing, low-code, AI, agile, sustainability, security, personal development and critical thinking. All while enjoying free food, snacks and drinks. And of course with rocking bands, house DJs and trippy tributes!

data.name: Home.What.P4
data.value: So if you are an IT professional and you love festivals, come to SpaceRockIT festival. Alone, with friends, or with your colleagues.

data.value: Because we are going to do it together! We will make it a wonderful event where your organisation can share in the fun too. SpaceRockIT festival offers various sponsorship packages.

data.name: Faq.A.What
data.value: SpaceRockIT festival is a unique festival where music and IT come together. The goal is to gain IT knowledge in a creative way, have fun, and enjoy live music.

data.name: Faq.Q.Day
data.value: What does the day look like?

data.name: Faq.A.Day
data.value: We start at 10:00 with the knowledge sessions: a central meeting, then parallel sessions at various locations on the festival site, supported by real festival facilities and small acts. At 16:00 we wrap up the knowledge part and turn the amplifiers up to 10 — live music on the various stages. The festival ends around 0:30.

data.name: Faq.Q.Lang
data.value: Is the festival only for Dutch-speaking visitors?

data.name: Faq.A.Lang
data.value: No, the festival is not exclusively for Dutch-speaking visitors. It welcomes people from various linguistic backgrounds and aims to be inclusive and diverse. You can use the language button in the top bar of this website to toggle between Dutch and English.

data.name: Faq.Q.Origin
data.value: How did the idea come about?

data.name: Faq.A.Origin
data.value: The idea came from Francis Welbie. He found current conferences a bit too standard and loves the atmosphere of festivals, so he combined the two. The organisation is supported (financially) by Si.Ledi BV (Screw It Let's Do It, Branson), which you will also find on the invoices.

data.name: Faq.Q.Logo
data.value: Where does the logo come from?

data.name: Faq.A.Logo
data.value: At SpaceRockIT we use the latest trends in IT, including the services of openai.com. Using DALL-E we created a logo from a few keywords. The text in the logo is loosely reminiscent of the festival, but has no direct meaning.

data.name: Faq.A.Buy
data.value: Ticket sales start on this site with the Super Early Bird Padawan. The "Get Tickets" button takes you to the order page, supported by CM.com. You receive your tickets and invoice via CM.com.

data.name: Faq.A.Money
data.value: The ticket price covers the costs, including the site, and supports the artists. Whatever is left is used to support artists and creators in the Netherlands and to keep improving this unique festival. No money is earned by the BV.

data.name: Faq.Q.Vat
data.value: Is there VAT on the tickets?

data.name: Faq.A.Vat
data.value: Yes. The tax authority regards this festival as a conference, so there is 21% VAT on the tickets. You will find this on the invoice.

data.name: Faq.Q.Refund
data.value: I can't make it after all — do I get my money back?

data.name: Faq.A.Refund
data.value: That's a shame! Just send us an e-mail. We'll get in touch — we are very accommodating with refunds.

data.value: We process personal data that you provide yourself, for example when buying a ticket, contacting us by e-mail or subscribing to news. Ticket sales and payments go through CM.com; CM.com's privacy policy applies to those.

data.name: Cookies.Intro
data.value: This workshop site currently places only one functional cookie for your language choice. No analytics, marketing or tracking tags are active.

data.name: Cookies.B1
data.value: Only the ASP.NET Core culture cookie is set when you switch between Dutch and English. That cookie stores only your language choice so the site stays in the same language on the next page.

data.name: Cookies.H2
data.value: Why is there no consent banner right now?

data.name: Cookies.B2
data.value: Because we use only a strictly functional preference cookie, this version does not need a consent banner. If analytics or any other non-essential cookies are added later, a minimal consent banner must be implemented before those scripts may go live.
